meta: How do self-driving cars see the road? With cameras, radar and LiDAR, then the hard part: predicting what others will do. Most cars sold today are only level 2.

muc.title: Taxis with no driver
muc.text: In a few cities in the US and China, you can already hail a taxi with no driver inside.

muc.title: The car's eyes
muc.text: The car sees the road with cameras, radar and LiDAR, the laser that measures distance, explained in video 5 of the channel.

muc.title: Guessing what others will do
muc.text: The hardest part is predicting. AI has to guess whether the motorbike next to it will turn or go straight, and only then choose a safe path.

muc.title: What level is your car?
muc.text: Most cars on sale only have level 2 driver assistance: lane keeping and distance keeping, while the driver still has to watch the road and hold the wheel.

muc.title: Read the manual carefully
muc.text: If your car has lane keeping or adaptive cruise control, open the manual to see what it expects from you, and don't hand everything over to the car.
